messages.text: What are the odds of hitting a block solo?
Solo on 40 TH/s it's a long shot — but it's a draw every ten minutes, for years, and you keep the machine. At $799 and 650 W, that's about $34/month at 10¢. What do you pay per kWh?
I pay about $.40 a kilo an hour

At 40¢, the 40T's 650 W runs about $187 a month — that's real money, and worth knowing before you buy. The draw at a full block (3.125 BTC) keeps going every ten minutes regardless, and you keep the machine.

At that rate a lot of people start smaller — the BC04 at 6 TH/s, $239, sips power. Want me to compare the two?
